lessons.trigger_condition: Uploaded tablet recordings show ambiguous country/category navigation, missing image metadata and inactive neural models below verified training gates.
lessons.prevention_rule: Use explicit edition/category routes and local image details; preserve identity-bound metadata and gap queues, quota-bound lossless images, pre-outcome eligible labels, and class/temporal/holdout gates.
validation_required: Deterministic UI actions and safe text
Persistent quotas, metadata identity and lossless pixel tests
Eligible-only query protocol3 and guarded training tests
Exact immutable source lineage and latest-head CI
lessons.safety_boundary: No fabricated labels/prices, lowered gates, provider block bypass, source self-rewriting or physical-device success claim.
